messages:
Maya K: Heads-up — last night's telemetry backfill stalled in the EU queue for ~3h. I kicked off a manual replay but we need a short-term mitigation and a longer-term plan.

Sanjay P: saw the alert. queue-depth spiked to 12k and workers kept recycling. CPU for rehydration pods maxed out.

Rachel S: Logs look like KV cache misses + repeated rehydration retries. BackfillBot showed a ton of 429s from the ingest API.

Tom B: 429s from ingest API means we hit per-tenant rate limits on the collector side? or the ingress autoscaler failed to spin up because of image pull throttles. checking.

Maya K: We need to avoid blowing past global quotas during backfills. Suggestion: introduce a backfill-specific token bucket that buys us steady throughput instead of spikes.

Sanjay P: Agree. Could set backfill bucket to 20% of spare capacity and smoothing window of 5m. Also add dynamic backoff when KV write latency > 200ms.

Ana R: From product side, customers with reserved Dedicated capacity expect backfills to not impact live traffic. Can we prioritize live inference over telemetry replays automatically?

Tom B: Yes — we already have routing policies. Quick fix: tag replay traffic with priority=low and route to overflow pool; if overflow is full, slow the replay.

Rachel S: For the immediate mitigation I put a temporary ingest throttle: `curl -X POST /internal/backfill/control -d '{"rate":1000}'` (BackfillBot applied). That brought queue down, but we still need better observability.

BackfillBot: applied rate limit 1000r/s to job id backfill-eu-2026-03-08. Jobs paused when overload detected.

Maya K: Thanks. Next items: 1) dashboard to show backfill vs live token consumption by region, 2) backfill orchestration that supports per-job pacing and priority, 3) failure-mode runbook.

Sanjay P: For dashboards — propose new panels in telemetry-backfills dashboard: queued messages, consumer lag (ms), applied rate limit, priority-routed fraction. I can whip up a grafana draft.

Ana R: Also want an SLA note for customers: best-effort replays won't count toward Dedicated throughput. Could add a config toggle per-customer.

Tom B: Longer-term: implement a pacing controller that uses token-bucket + PID-style adjuster based on downstream latency and error-rate. Pseudocode:
```
while not done:
  if downstream_error_rate > 0.02: sleep(backoff())
  tokens = token_bucket.take(n)
  send_batch(tokens)
  adjust_controller(metrics)
```

Maya K: Nice. Who owns short-term work? Two actionables: Sanjay — grafana panels + alert refinements. Tom — overflow routing + per-job tag rollout. Rachel — update runbook and incident doc. Ana — customer-facing config + comms. I'll draft the pacing RFC next week.

Sanjay P: I'll post a grafana preview by EOD tomorrow.

Rachel S: Updating postmortem template and runbook now, will ping once done.

Tom B: I'll open PR for job-tagging and a small router change. Plan to canary in staging then EU.

Ana R: I'll draft the product note and a suggested default: backfill-priority: low for Hosted by default, opt-in for high.

Maya K: One last thing — can we add a synthetic replay job that runs in staging to exercise the whole pipeline weekly? Would catch this earlier.

Sanjay P: good call. I'll add a cron job and a smoke test that fails the PR if replay path regresses.

Maya K: Thanks team. I'll close this thread after the first PRs land. :thumbsup:
